utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can be there around 9 with my ladder and toolbox, and the ladder’s plenty tall for one-story gutter work.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps a lot. I was going to start on the fence first, but if the gutters need doing at 9, I can meet you there and help after.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, let’s start with the gutters at 9, and then we can swing over to the fence once that’s handled.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If people are really using the side street and keeping the driveway clear, I could probably stop by for a bit—I just don’t want it turning into a parking mess.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That helps, but can you confirm who’s actually committed to using the side street so the driveway stays clear?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I only know Quinn said that’s what they’re telling everyone, so I’d want to double-check before counting on it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Noah—send me the details once you’ve got them straight, and I’ll pass the plan along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, thanks, Vik—I’m still sorting the details, but I’ll get them to you as soon as I’ve got the plan straight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect—once you send the plan over, I’ll let everyone know we’re doing the repair drive soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mara, Faye can help after school drop-off until about 2, so I’m thinking we give her sorting or phone outreach in that window, or a from-home task if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds perfect—let’s put Faye on sorting or phone outreach in that window, since Joel’s already on carpentry and Priya’s handling supplies while we still need someone to lead the roof work.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—I’ll keep Faye on sorting or phone outreach after drop-off, and I’ll start asking around for someone who can lead the roof work.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Dane, I’ve got the list here—we still need the fence patched and the tools sorted for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll swing by a bit late, but I can still help out for a while once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps, Dane—if you can, start with sorting the tools when you get here, and we’ll keep the fence patching moving in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve heard, Milo’s definitely bringing a toolbox and fasteners, and Priya’s set aside bike tubes and patch kits for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds great—if there’s sorting or calls to make after school drop-off and before 2, I can take that on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d help a ton, Faye—I’ll pass along that you’re free after drop-off and before 2 for sorting or making calls.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it’s by the community center parking lot, but I’d check the flyer to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds right to me too; I’ll bring the flyer when I stop by so we can confirm the time and exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—bring the flyer, and we’ll check the exact spot and time quick.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Leo—what do you need me to take care of first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: If you can, get the item list finalized and send it over; once I’ve got that, I’ll handle pickups this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll finalize the item list and send it over to you shortly so you can get started on pickups this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m pulling people together for the repair drive this weekend—swing by around 10 if you can, and bring anything that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—are folks still collecting tools for the repair drive, and what do you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, we’re still gathering tools—extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and a couple of folding tables would help a ton if you’ve got any to lend.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Eli, do you know the exact spot for the repair drive, or should I confirm it on the flyer at the community center parking lot?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Please confirm it on the flyer, Opal, so we’re working from the exact spot. Once you have it, we can note it and keep the rest of the plan straightforward.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I’ll check the flyer and confirm whether it’s exactly at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, do we have any one-story gutter jobs lined up for around 9, and who’s pairing with Gus when he gets there?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check I’ve got this right first—we still have the porch steps and the center’s roof as the main priorities, but I don’t have a confirmed 9 o’clock gutter job or a partner for Gus yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—can you confirm now whether we’re assigning Gus to the center’s roof or finding him a one-story gutter job, and who’s working with him?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: If Oren can get the list set by this afternoon, I can coordinate while I’m out and loop Leo in for pickups.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do that, Ira—I’ll get the list set this afternoon and put my toolbox and fold-up table on it so we know what’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect—that gives us what we need; send it over this afternoon and I’ll coordinate with Leo while I’m out.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
